civilopediaText.text: Grade A aptitude (甲等资质): an essence sea that fills most of the aperture and refills fast. Rare, prized, and watched closely by everyone.
Grade B aptitude (乙等资质): a solid essence sea. The backbone of a clan's next generation.
Grade C aptitude (丙等资质): an ordinary essence sea. Ordinary is enough, for those willing to work for it.
Grade D aptitude (丁等资质): a shallow essence sea that refills slowly. Such students eat more stones and are given fewer chances.

name: Killer Move
uniques: [This Unit] loses the [Killer Move] promotion <upon turn start> <for units without [White Jade Gu]> <for units without [Moon Raiment]>

civilopediaText.text: A killer move (杀招): the unit's Gu strike together as one technique. It needs a rank-two fusion Gu to hold it, and it dies with that Gu.
Bear Strength Gu (熊力蛊), the Xiong emblem, lends its user a bear's strength. The Xiong clan has little else and needs little else.
Stream Gu (溪流蛊), the Bai emblem, named for running water. It keeps its user on his feet between fights.

uniques: [This Unit] loses the [Orchid Hunger] status <upon turn start> <when above [-1] [Moon Orchid]>

civilopediaText.text: The moon orchids have run out and the Gu are starving. If the orchids do not return in time, some of them will not survive the wait.

civilopediaText.text: The pork has run out and the boar Gu are starving. A starving Gu does not fight, and a Gu that starves long enough dies.

name: Jade Hunger

civilopediaText.text: The jade has run out and the jade Gu are starving. Rank-two Gu last longer than rank-one Gu, but not forever.

name: Wine Hunger
uniques: [This Unit] loses the [Wine Hunger] status <upon turn start> <when above [-1] [Wine]>

civilopediaText.text: The wine has run out and the Liquor Worm is starving. It will not wait long.
